mcphone.vault.title: Vault passphrase
mcphone.vault.warn.no_recovery: Forget the passphrase and the vault data is gone for good. No recovery, no hint question, the server owner cannot reset it.
mcphone.vault.warn.never_leaves: The passphrase never leaves this computer, never goes into a packet, and is never written to disk.
mcphone.vault.warn.confirm: Type it once more. It will not submit unless both match.
mcphone.vault.mismatch: The two entries do not match
mcphone.vault.rollback: Vault data went backwards in version; refusing to use it
mcphone.vault.bad_tag: Cannot open this vault record: wrong passphrase, or it is not yours
mcphone.sig.invalid: Invalid signature — this package may have been altered in transit. Installing is not advised.
mcphone.sig.key_changed: The author key changed. Last time it was %s, now it is %s. The author may have switched devices, or it may not be the same person.
mcphone.sig.unsigned: Unsigned. There is no way to tell who made it or whether it was altered.
mcphone.sig.unknown: Signature valid. Author fingerprint %s — you have not installed anything from them before.
mcphone.sig.removed: This app was signed before; this copy is not. Either someone else made it, or it was swapped along the way.
mcphone.sig.install_note: Apps can only use the UI components and interfaces MCphone provides. They cannot read or write your files and cannot run programs. A signature confirms who made it and whether it was altered — not whether the contents are safe.
mcphone.sig.confirm_prompt: To continue, type the new fingerprint above exactly:
mcphone.sig.confirm_mismatch: That does not match the new fingerprint
mcphone.sig.confirm_tick: I understand there is no author to check against, install anyway
mcphone.sig.server_blocked: This author is blocked by the server owner
mcphone.sig.server_not_allowed: This server only allows authors on its list
mcphone.sig.key_unprotected: ⚠ This file is not protected at the system level — owner-only access could not be set on this machine.
mcphone.sig.key_lost: Lost is lost: no recovery, no reset. Export a backup now.
mcphone.sig.key_none: No signing key yet. Generate one and you can sign your own apps.
mcphone.sig.key_fingerprint: Author fingerprint (put it on your release page so players can compare)
mcphone.sig.key_broken: A key file exists but cannot be read, or the pair does not match. Do not delete it — copy author.key and author.pub from your backup back into config/mcphone/keys/ and reopen this page.
mcphone.sig.key_exported: Backup written to %s (contains author.key and author.pub); to restore, copy both back into config/mcphone/keys/. These are private keys — do not toss them on a cloud drive.

mcphone.app.settings.desc: Manage wallpaper, device name and installed apps.
mcphone.app.chat.desc: Chat with other players on the server. They receive it even when offline.
mcphone.app.camera.desc: Capture what you see and save it to the gallery.
mcphone.app.gallery.desc: Browse the photos you have taken.
mcphone.app.music.desc: Play your own music, and discs too.
mcphone.app.ender_chest.desc: Open your ender chest anywhere. It is the vanilla one — fully shared with block ender chests, across dimensions.
mcphone.app.notes.desc: Jot things down. Notes follow you, survive death, and can be printed into a book to hand to someone.
mcphone.app.waystone.desc: Open the Waystones selection screen and travel to any activated waystone. Requires Waystones.
mcphone.about.author: Author
mcphone.compat.netmusic: NetMusic (net songs in the disc bay)
mcphone.store.not_purchased: You have not purchased this app yet
mcphone.app.browser.desc: Browse the web from your phone. Opens a panel much larger than the phone screen. Requires MCEF.
mcphone.browser.need_mcef: First use downloads about 200 MB of runtime; try again shortly
mcphone.chat.friend_self_full: Your friend list is full (max %s), remove someone first
mcphone.chat.friend_peer_inbox_full: They have too many pending requests, try later
mcphone.chat.friend_unknown_player: The server has never seen that player
mcphone.chat.teleport_disabled: Friend teleport is off on this server
mcphone.chat.image_disabled: Sending photos is off on this server
mcphone.chat.image_too_fast: Too many images waiting to send, give it a moment
mcphone.chat.image_broken: That photo did not go through, try again
mcphone.chat.image_store_failed: The server could not store that photo
mcphone.chat.image_too_big: That image is over this server's size limit
mcphone.chat.image_encode_failed: That photo is too big to send
mcphone.chat.image_unreadable: Can't open this image — unknown format, or the file is broken
mcphone.chat.image_webp: That file is really a WebP; renaming it to .gif won't help. Convert it to GIF or PNG first
mcphone.app.clock.desc: The time in game, the time out here, and how long until dark. Works in the Nether too — the vanilla clock just spins there.
mcphone.app.weather.desc: What the sky is doing, and what it's good for. Knows a dry desert storm from snow on a mountain — not just "it's raining".
mcphone.weather.advice.clear: A good time to be out. Zombies and skeletons burn in daylight, so the road is safer than it is at night.
mcphone.weather.advice.clear.night: Mobs are spawning on the surface. Put down some torches, or just sleep through it.
mcphone.weather.advice.rain: Good fishing weather — bites come noticeably faster in the rain. Rain also puts out fires.
mcphone.weather.advice.snow: Bring a shovel. Enough snow blocks makes a snow golem, and snowballs still knock things around.
mcphone.weather.advice.thunder: Dark as night, so mobs spawn on the surface. But lightning turns a creeper charged — now is the time.
mcphone.weather.advice.dry: It's raining elsewhere; not a drop here. The sky still dims, so watch your step.
mcphone.weather.advice.none: No weather in this dimension. Head back to the Overworld to see rain.
mcphone.hud.enabled_hint: On in your off hand, on your last page. Tap %s anytime.
mcphone.hud.interact_hint: Tap %s for a cursor: drag edge, Ctrl+scroll to resize.
mcphone.hud.place_hint: Drag to place  ·  Scroll to resize  ·  R to reset  ·  ESC when done
mcphone.config.ui_scale_snap: Snap UI size to crisp values
mcphone.config.hud_enabled: Show the phone as a HUD when in the off hand
mcphone.app.reader.desc: Every guide book in the pack, in one shelf. Tap one to open it. The books stay where they are - you just stop carrying them. Requires Patchouli.
mcphone.app.quests.desc: The pack's quest book, one tap from the home screen. Chapters, progress and rewards are still FTB Quests' - the book just stops taking up a slot. Requires FTB Quests.
mcphone.app.terminal.desc: Opens your storage terminal straight from the phone - AE2, Refined Storage and Tom's all count. Tapping it opens the slot first: put a terminal in and every later tap opens that one. Rather not install? The slot page's Open terminal button uses the one in your inventory. Requires one of those storage mods.
mcphone.terminal.no_remote: %s can't be opened remotely - hold it and point at a terminal block instead.
mcphone.terminal.open_failed: %s errored out; that terminal can't be opened. See the log.
mcphone.terminal.inventory_space_require: Free one inventory slot to open this Refined Storage terminal.
mcphone.reader.empty_hint: Mods that ship a guide book show up here on their own. None at all usually means this pack has no mod using them.
mcphone.reader.no_match_hint: Try another word - book name, mod name and mod id all match.
mcphone.reader.txt.broken_hint: The file may be too large (over 32 MB), locked by another program, or not text at all. The reason is in the game log (latest.log, search for MCphone).
mcphone.reader.shelf_empty_hint: Drop .txt novels into config/mcphone/reader/books/ (the "Folder" link above opens it), or drag the files onto the game window - they land here directly, no need to star them. Mod guide books live under "All books"; tap the star to bring one here.
mcphone.reader.shelf_empty_hint_no_txt: Tap the star on a row under "All books" to put it here. Keep the few you actually read on the shelf.
mcphone.picker.title: Choose an image
mcphone.economy.scoreboard.no_server: The server is not running yet, so this ledger cannot be read.
mcphone.economy.scoreboard.off_thread: This operation is off the server main thread; the scoreboard cannot be changed.
mcphone.economy.scoreboard.no_objective: The scoreboard has no usable objective for this currency (missing, cannot be created, or read-only).
mcphone.economy.unavailable.data_locked: This currency's saved data could not be read and is locked; the original data is kept as-is (see the server log).
mcphone.economy.unavailable.main_thread_: The server is busy. Nothing was done; try again shortly.
mcphone.economy.unavailable.queue_full: Too many currency requests are queued. Nothing was done; try again shortly.
mcphone.economy.unavailable.stopping: The server is stopping. Nothing was done.
mcphone.economy.unavailable.interrupted: The request was interrupted. Nothing was done.
mcphone.economy.unavailable.wait_budget: This call waited too long for the server; the remaining currency operations were skipped.
mcphone.economy.adapter.unavailable: The external economy mod is unavailable right now (not installed, not loaded yet, or reporting itself unavailable).
mcphone.economy.emc_legacy.no_escrow: The legacy wallet interface has no escrow, so this currency cannot be used for marketplace trades.
mcphone.economy.emc_legacy.no_balance: The legacy wallet interface does not expose balances.
mcphone.economy.scoreboard.unknown_playe: This player's name is unknown (not seen for a long time, or never joined); the scoreboard keys balances by name, so it cannot be read.
mcphone.economy.no_such_currency: This server has no such currency (the server owner may have changed the configuration).
mcphone.economy.invalid_amount: Invalid amount: missing, or too large to represent.
